answer: To resist Sybil attacks, a network emits a cryptographic pulse to trigger decentralized multi-agent auditing across interaction graphs. Agents stake valuable capital; any detected Sybil bottleneck during topological cut verifications triggers instant stake slashing, reducing the rogue deposit to a dying ember. Meanwhile, an honest beacon anchors validated graph entropy, imposing superlinear attacker cost as fabricating distinct audit cuts scales combinatorially.
